title: relay installs with one command into ~/.relay/src
what: A user installs relay with one command (curl ... install.sh | sh): it clones relay into ~/.relay/src, installs the tools from deps.toml, runs the global part once, and puts `relay` into ~/.local/bin. relay's state stays beside it in ~/.relay (ledger, backups, personal overlay). Claude Code loads relay's plugins from that folder (a directory marketplace pointing at ~/.relay/src), so one copy of the code serves both the command and the plugins. `relay update` pulls the new version and syncs; it keeps the user's own edits to the code and, on a conflict with the new version, stops and names the files, losing nothing. The owner's ~/relay stays the owner's working copy, pointed at by the path setting.
why: Owner, 26 Oct: "Как пользователь будет устанавливать наше приложение, как это выглядит ? Папку на устройство, стоит ли устанавливать в ~/relay, как происходит установка похожих приложений", then "Стоит ли пользователю давать доступ к исходному коду ? Как будут устанавливаться плагины Claude ? Как после будут подключаться новые проекты", then "Под открыть код я имел ввиду дать возможность изменять локальную версию в ~/.relay/app / app не звучит, может что-то другое ?", then on the front's recommendations (folder ~/.relay/src with state beside; update keeps edits and stops on a conflict; plugins from relay's folder, not a GitHub /plugin copy; one install command like oh-my-zsh): "Полностью согласен с твоими рекомендациями". Facts, 26 Oct: install today is 5 manual steps (README "Install"); ~/relay is assumed in install.sh:21 and plugins/front/bin/relay:11; ~/.relay holds ledger, backup, bench, evals, state. Part of publish-relay-to-a-public-repo-from-the-private. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
where: install.sh the installer (today it expects the folder at ~/relay, install.sh:21)
README.md and START_HERE.md the install steps
